segments.name: Real Estate Properties
segments.description: Owns and operates grocery-anchored shopping centers, leasing retail space to tenants called Neighbors.
segments.evidence: Our Real Estate Properties segment derives a majority of its revenue from the lease contracts it enters into as a lessor, which are all in the form of operating leases.

revenueModel.text: Neighbor tenants pay rent for leased shopping center space, plus reimbursements for common area maintenance, insurance and real estate taxes.
revenueModel.evidence: Further, our lease contracts typically provide for reimbursements from tenants for common area maintenance, insurance, and real estate tax expense.
